activity.notes: Irene returned to imperial power in 792 as co-regent/co-ruler alongside Constantine VI. This distinct Activity preserves the interruption of her authority in 790-792 and does not collapse the joint-rule phase into either her earlier regency or her later sole reign.

sources.title: Administrative Elites and Political Change
sources.citation_text: Cambridge scholarship states that Irene acted as co-regent to Constantine VI in 780-790 and 792-797, then reigned in her own right from 797 to 802.

sources.title: The Empress Irene the Athenian
sources.citation_text: Steven Runciman's study treats Irene's political career and imperial authority as distinct phases culminating in her unprecedented sovereign rule.
